findings.title: Title Screen Text Overload
findings.problem: The tagline 'One car. Sixteen cities. A highway that wants you dead.' is too small and low-contrast against the background, making it illegible at a glance.
findings.why: It undermines the title's impact and fails to communicate core themes quickly, reducing player immersion and leaving the game’s identity unclear during first impressions.
findings.fix: Increase font size and contrast of the tagline to match the title, using a bold, saturated color (e.g., bright cyan or white) against the dark overlay.

findings.title: Radar UI Lacks Feedback
findings.problem: The radar is a static black circle with no visible sweep arc or target indicators — it reads as broken or inert rather than as an active instrument.
findings.why: Players cannot gauge direction, detect threats, or orient themselves in real-time, which breaks immersion and makes navigation feel unintuitive or broken.
findings.fix: Add a glowing sweep arc animating clockwise and faint green dots for detected targets, even if none are present, to signal active functionality.

findings.title: HUD Overlap on Road Screen
findings.problem: The mission text bar overlaps directly with the road’s lane markings, visually obscuring critical gameplay information during motion.
findings.why: This creates visual clutter and reduces legibility during high-speed play, forcing players to pause or squint, which disrupts flow and can cause missed objectives.
findings.fix: Move the HUD bar to the top edge of the screen with padding, or use a semi-transparent background to prevent overlap with road geometry.

findings.title: Condition Panel Misaligned Labels
findings.where: arena, road, city screens, right side
findings.problem: Labels like 'FRONT: - not fitted' are misaligned vertically and lack consistent spacing, causing visual confusion when scanning for vehicle status.
findings.why: Inconsistent alignment forces players to reorient their eyes, slowing reaction time and increasing cognitive load when checking equipment status under pressure.
findings.fix: Standardize label alignment using left-aligned text with uniform padding and line height, ensuring all rows start at the same vertical baseline.

findings.title: Constructor UI Confusing Layout
findings.problem: The weapon slots are labeled 'Weapon 1' through 'Weapon 10' but have no visual indicator showing which slot is selected or editable, creating ambiguity during setup.
findings.why: Without clear selection feedback, players waste time guessing which row to edit, leading to frustration and errors when configuring vehicles.
findings.fix: Highlight the currently selected row with a glow or underline, and add a small icon next to each slot indicating its state (empty, mounted, locked).
